about: T-488: the * SINK items. A wild GYARADOS (FLOW and VECTOR, so SIGNAL is super-effective on it) is invoked through DEBUG -> ENCOUNTER, handed a SIGNAL SINK in battle (gBattleMons[1].item poked; its HP raised to 999 so it lives to be hit twice), and the lead is taught THUNDERBOLT (SIGNAL) by the THEATRE. The first hit is halved with the DRAFT line and the item is spent; the second lands whole. Then PewterCity_Mart with MARK 1 held: the stock gains the LEGACY sinks and those that beat LEGACY. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.
